record_title: Real compact operators are single commutators of real compact operators
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The universal constant is not optimized; finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces are necessarily excluded; no stronger Schatten-ideal membership of the factors or extension to general real Banach spaces is proved. Fan--Fong (1987), Fan (1984), and Anderson (1977) were not all inspected in original full text and are the principal residual prior-art sources.
